name: monday-html-widget
description: Widget personalizado para monday.com que renderiza código HTML/CSS/JS arbitrario

scripts.build:dist: rm -rf dist && mkdir dist && cp -R index.html src vendor dist/
scripts.deploy:monday: npm run build:dist && npx -y @mondaycom/apps-cli code:push -c -d dist -i $MONDAY_APP_VERSION_ID
